assessmentName: Eastern Corn Belt Plains reference assessment
author: StreamCurves regional analysis (STAF)
revisionNotes: Reference condition is the fixed landscape-pressure screen least-disturbed-v1 (strict), wadeable non-canal frame. 0 of 44 stations of this ecoregion pass. 0 reference curves use local stations, 20 borrow from a wider region, 5 metrics use fixed criteria, and 7 metrics are withheld for insufficient reference support. 19 published curves are carried forward unchanged from version 7, and 1 were rebuilt because the data verification corrected values they rested on.  No station of this ecoregion passes the reference screen, so every reference curve here borrows its reference stations from a parent ecoregion.
sourceCitation: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 55), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.14-provisional
